name: ritm-touch-typing
description: Russian and English touch typing tutor with progressive lessons

scripts.format: prettier --write .github src scripts tests package.json README.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check .github src scripts tests package.json README.md .prettierrc.json
scripts.test:unit: node tests/verify.mjs && node tests/exercises.mjs && node tests/storage.mjs && node tests/progress.mjs && node tests/hints.mjs && node tests/html.mjs && node tests/hand-motion.mjs && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: npm run build && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.mjs --grep @smoke
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c tests/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
